fact: APPRENDRE (AUF) states that, at the time of its experts' review of March to April 2023, the Ministère de l'Enseignement Primaire, Secondaire et de l'Alphabétisation did not yet have a digital information and management system such as an espace numérique de travail, only the design of a biometric teacher registration system having been started; the work produced a specification for a future ENT and trained 37 staff of the DSIC.
title: République du Congo : Rédaction d'un cahier des charges pour la création d'une plateforme numérique au service de la communauté éducative
publisher: APPRENDRE, Agence universitaire de la Francophonie
